items.title: Entitled Dad and Brat Get Busted at Local Con
items.text:
Entitled Dad and Brat Get Busted at Local Con
Before we begin, English is my first language, I'm not on mobile and I'll do what I can about formatting. 

ED = The Newest form of the Traveler  
EK = Spawn of the Gozarian  
Me = The reincarnation of Egon Spengler   
ND = Nice Dad  
NG = Nice Girl  
SG = Security Guard  
M = Mom (who was also working security)

So, last year or so I went to my local comic/fandom/etc. convention. We'll call it 'Blankville Comic-Con' for now. It had been my second year at the con and my first year in cosplay. I'd gone in a Ghostbuster costume I had meant for a bigger con in my state's capital year before last but didn't finish before the con came due to unrelated reasons. 

Now BCC isn't a huge con like a few others you could name but it had a decent turn out and got quite a few well known names, from comic artists who worked for or used to work for big name publishers to a few former Power Ranger actors. All in all, it was a decent con that had been running for the past four or so years. And going in cosplay for the first time to this con felt rather confidence boosting as normally I'm not a very social person thanks to my autism. I lost count of the times people would look at me and shout 'WHO YA GONNA CALL?!' and got quite a few compliments on my costume. 

While I was walking around, I got stopped by a nice dad (**ND**) and his daughter (**NG**), who looked about 12 or so, asking if they could get a picture with me because the daughter loved Ghostbusters. I obviously said yes because it was always nice to meet a fellow fan and me and the daughter got in front of her dad and got ready to take the pic. And just as he takes it I feel what I think is someone hit me in the side like they were trying to hit a home run with my kidney as the ball.

We both turn to see a kid (**EK**) who is probably less than 10 swinging around a cheap wooden sword probably bought from one of the vendors about to take a second wack at my side. This time I manage to grab it from his hand and pull it away, hoping his hit didn't leave anything worse than a light bruise.

**Me:** \-as calmly and firmly as I can- Kid, that was not very nice. You can't go around hitting people with things!

**EK** immediately started screaming and stomping, demanding his sword back in the shrillest whiniest voice imaginable. Like nails on a chalkboard combined shrill. His tantrum immediately brings over our entitled parent for the evening, **ED,** who gives me a look like I had run over his grandmother. He was a little taller than I was (I'm 5'6") and built like the Stay-Puft Marshmallow Man had let himself go as he waddled over to me and jabbed a fat finger in my direction.

**ED**: What did you do to my son, a$$hole?!

**Me**: Me? Your son is running around hitting people while you were nowhere to be found!!

**ED**: He's a kid! He's just playing around, that's what this con is for! Now give back his sword or I'll show you hitting! 

Now I obviously don't do this and slide it under my proton pack for safe keeping until the matter was resolved.

**Me:** Sir, I will do no such thing until you get your son under control and both of you apologize for his behavior!

At this, **ED** joins his little spawn in screaming and shouting at me, even trying to push me back though I step out of the way before he could. Finally after what felt like ages a pair of security guards march over after **NG** had gone off to get their attention. One of these security guards happens to be my mom as both she and my dad had been working security at the event for the past couple years (My dad was working ticket and bag check at the main entrance). 

**M**: Is everything okay here? 

**ED**: This f\*cker stole my kids stuff and felt up that girl! -pointing at **NG**\-

Now anyone with at even a single brain cell could tell he was lying and trying to get me kicked out, so my mom just turned to me and asked:

**M**: AllISeeAreGems, what is he talking about?

I explain, along with corroboration from both **ND** and **NG**, that **EK** had been swinging the wooden sword around and hit me in the side as hard as he could. All the while **ED** was screaming obscenities and trying to interrupt saying that I was really a pedophile who had been trying to grope both his son and **NG**. Now in the midst of this torrent of chaos and shouting, my mom's coworker (**SG**) happens to glance at **ED**'s wrist and points out the one thing all of us had somehow missed.

**SG**: Sir, where is your wrist band? (The door staff gave out paper wrist bands so that attendees could get back in easily if they had to leave for some reason)

**ED**: -now looking rather nervous as he grabbed his son's now obviously bandless wrist to try and pull him away- We didn't get one! They were all out! -trying to back away-

My mom pulled out her radio and contact her supervisor about **ED** and **EK** just as the two make a run for the back of the convention area where the food trucks were. They don't make it far as a couple of guys who had been manning a nearby Medieval Combat Sports booth got in their path and helped drag them back to my mom and her coworker. Turns out **ED** had snuck them in over the waist high barrier in the back and had let **EK** run amok through the convention while he tried to get as much free con swag as he could (and a few not-so free items they found on his person later).

Eventually they handed him off to the Sheriff's Deputy that had been outside doing weapon and prop checks for arrest and we gave our statements all over again. I didn't press charges since I wasn't hurt too bad but he still got cuffed for trespassing and theft while **EK** had to wait around for a relative to come pick him up.

Finally after all that, NG got the long overdue photo with me in costume, I thanked them both for their help and we went our merry ways.

TL;DR: ED lets EK run around convention, hits me, tries to say I'm a pedo and gets arrested for sneaking into the con.

([My Costume for anyone interested](https://imgur.com/a/1xSjPsu))
